killedBy: the AudioContext override reaches every tool that boots the app screens/record.mjs installs the override before every navigation
why: Leaves the two real `AudioContext`s the app builds at boot -- Howler's, when `createAudioEngine` first touches `Howler.volume()`, and `engine.ts`'s `ensureCtx`. On a host whose audio service never connects each constructor returns only after an internal 20-second timeout, so the page blocks for ~40 s before `load` fires and screen RECORDING wedges while screen CAPTURE, guarded by `capture-keeps-the-audio-context-constructor`, still works -- the pair that made #860 look like an intermittent local fault.
